title: Esses channel overrides (overrides-1)
description: <Project>/channels/overrides.json (02 section 6.3, 06 section 13.1, D-010, D-013): per-channel display settings keyed by channel name as written (display unit, decimals, colour index, autoscale and manual scale, interpolation, warning and fault limits). Every number is a {v, unit} object whose unit is kept as written, so a canonical document round-trips byte-identically. Unknown top-level members and unknown members of an override are allowed and preserved; the limit and value records are closed. Channel names that differ only in case are allowed (lookups take the exact spelling first).

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

channels.description: Overrides keyed by channel name; unknown channels are kept untouched.

channelOverride.description: ChannelOverrides::Entry. Every member is optional; members not listed here are preserved.

colourIndex.description: Index into the scheme's channel palette.

limits.description: Warning or fault limits: a lower and/or an upper bound.

unitValue.description: A persisted number with its unit (D-010): {"v": number, "unit": symbol}, "" for a unitless value. The value is in the unit as written; readers convert, writers keep the written unit.

unitSymbolOrEmpty.description: A unit symbol or alias of the unit registry (units-1), or "" for the unitless unit; no leading or trailing white space.

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
